content:
maya_support: Customer (Dedicated tenant) reporting canary rollout health charts stuck on 'In progress' for three canaries in eu-west-1 since ~03:40 UTC. Console shows no heartbeat updates, metric panels show "no data" for token/latency series. Customer API traffic fine; app experiencing perceived rollout hang. Asking for escalation and ETA.

maya_support: repro steps provided by customer:
1) Console > Rollouts > <tenant> > canary list
2) click canary -> header shows In progress + spinner, timeline empty
3) confirmed backend API calls to /rollouts/status return 200 with last_seen unchanged
4) tried console refresh + browser hard refresh; no change

maya_support: attached sanitized screenshot link (redacted) and three canary ids: c-77e4, c-77e5, c-77e6

liam_runtime: ack. Please paste status-sync logs around the incident window and which status-sync image/tag is running. Also capture kafka consumer group status.

maya_support: pasted sanitized logs:
```
[03:31:07] INFO status-sync: starting sync loop for canary c-77e4
[03:31:08] WARN status-sync: publish delta failed: KafkaTimeoutError: Local: Timed out
[03:31:20] WARN status-sync: skipping update, advisory lock busy for canary c-77e5
[03:31:41] ERROR status-sync: consumer re-balance failed: IllegalStateException: group id mismatch
[03:32:10] INFO status-sync: requeued canary c-77e6 attempts=4
```

maya_support: pod name status-sync-7c9f4b (image=registry.redwood/status-sync:v2.8.1)

alan_infra: I ran quick infra checks in eu-west-1:
- kafka topic metrics-updates backlog ~24k messages
- consumer group (status-sync-group) shows only 1/8 members assigned, rest in STALLED
- redis queue empty
- postgres advisory lock contention spikes at same timeframe
- no node resource pressure observed

zoe_sre: sounds like group rebalancing / group id collision. Any recent config change?

deploy-bot: deploy event: status-sync image=registry.redwood/status-sync:v2.8.1 deployed eu-west-1 at 2026-03-17T03:28:11Z by ci-pipeline

liam_runtime: hypothesis: an interpolation bug in Helm chart caused consumer.group to include a tenant template token in some replicas. That would cause inconsistent group ids across pods -> unstable rebalance -> most pods in STALLED state -> consumer lag -> status updates not applied and UI shows stale state. Also seeing DB advisory lock warns which amplify retries.

alan_infra: investigating pod env and started 'kubectl describe pod' on a few. Found some pods launched with CONSUMER_GROUP=status-sync-group and others with CONSUMER_GROUP=status-sync-group-{{ .Values.tenant }} (literal templated string). Looks like a deployment templating error in the last chart release.

liam_runtime: mitigation plan:
1) temporarily scale status-sync to 6 replicas to increase working consumers and help drain backlog
2) restart all status-sync pods to pick up the corrected config (we'll patch the deployment to use the fixed group id string)
3) raise advisory lock timeouts and monitor DB contention if needed
4) monitor kafka consumer lag and console heartbeats for affected canaries

maya_support: relayed mitigation and ETA (~25m) to customer. They reported it's impacting staging->prod rollouts and asked for progress updates.

alan_infra: applied hotfix to deployment (replaced templated value with fixed env var) and executed a rolling restart:
```
kubectl -n redwood set env deployment/status-sync CONSUMER_GROUP=status-sync-group --region eu-west-1
kubectl -n redwood rollout restart deployment/status-sync --region eu-west-1
```

deploy-bot: rollout:start deployment/status-sync eu-west-1 at 2026-03-17T03:52:04Z by alan_infra

zoe_sre: scaling to 6 replicas now to speed drain. Watching consumer-group assignment.

liam_runtime: also adjusted DB advisory lock backoff threshold and added a short jitter to reduce thundering herd while backlog drains.

alan_infra: after restarts we saw a fast rebalance and partitions redistributed evenly across replicas. Kafka consumer lag started to fall from 24k -> 6k within 10 minutes.

liam_runtime: confirmed status updates processed for canaries c-77e4/c-77e5/c-77e6. Heartbeat timestamps advanced and console charts populated. Canaries transitioned from In progress -> Healthy/Completed as expected.

maya_support: customer confirmed dashboards repopulated and reported their rollout resumed. They said thanks for rapid response. :thumbsup:

zoe_sre: post-incident follow-ups:
- CI chart lint: fail deploy if Helm templating produces unresolved templates in env values (add test for '{{' or '}}' inside env strings)
- add alert for consumer group partition assignment ratio below 50% across replicas
- add advisory lock contention SLO + pager if lock wait > 5s for >1m
- add runbook for status-sync: how to verify CONS_GROUP, draining procedure, and safe scale settings

liam_runtime: filed infra ticket INFRA-9872 for chart fix + CI lint. Will attach notes and logs. Reopen if recurrence.

maya_support: closing support thread and noting customer satisfaction.
